title: Valid Subarrays With Matching Sum Digits I
summary: Given an integer array nums and an integer digit x, count the subarrays where the sum's first and last digits both equal x.
statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer digit x, count the subarrays where the sum's first and last digits both equal x.
constraints: nums contains positive integers and x is one decimal digit.
A subarray qualifies when the decimal representation of its sum starts and ends with x.
Return the count of nonempty qualifying subarrays.
hints: Fix each left boundary and accumulate sums as the right boundary grows.
Convert each positive sum to decimal text.
Compare both its first and last character with x.
Every nonempty subarray is visited exactly once.
editorial: Every nonempty subarray is visited exactly once.

tests.explanation: The two single-value sums of one and the two different subarrays summing to 101 give four.
The complete subarray sums to five, which starts and ends with digit five.
